Wycheproof Test Vectors
------------------------
Project Wycheproof is a community managed repository of test vectors that can be used by cryptography library
developers to test against known attacks, specification inconsistencies, and other various implementation bugs.

See third_party/wycheproof_testvectors/LICENSE.

```
SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
```

===== musl 1.2.5 from Rust 1.95.0 target =====
Source: https://git.musl-libc.org/cgit/musl/tree/?h=v1.2.5
Toolchain: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/1.95.0/src/ci/docker/scripts/musl-toolchain.sh
Final static linkage uses Rust's bundled libc (mallocng); Zig compiles native C dependencies only.
